title: Typed module options, panel surface closure and retirement of GateMode
summary: Panels carry typed readonly module options (`PanelBuilder::options()`, `Panel::options(Class)`) that are fingerprinted canonically through `Panels\Internal\CanonicalMetadata`; `AuditPlugin` contributes `Audit\AuditOptions` and `retentionIn(PanelRecipe)` is gone; the raw compiled lists of `Panel` are `@internal`; `PanelBuilder::panelId()` exists; `GateMode`, `gate()`, `defaults.gate.mode` and `GateModeCheck` are retired; grant fields reject the reserved `azg_` prefix.
why: Owners read their own settings from the panel instead of introspecting another class's recipe (D8, architecture#spi-catalog typed module options); raw slot lists are not a supported surface (contracts#panel); a single-case enum is not a configuration (api-compatibility). Hard risk: options must be panel-local and part of the fingerprint, or a second panel/stale catalog could read another panel's retention (I14).

include: `PanelBuilder::options(object $options): static` and `PanelBuilder::panelId(): string` (knowledge/contracts#panel-builder): rejects non-readonly objects, a second object of one class on one layer, and values containing models, builders, requests, containers or bound closures (`DefinitionException`); layers merge by the existing precedence (provider → plugins → configurePanels; later layer replaces the object of the same class)
`Panel::options(string $class): ?object` (contracts#panel); sealed definition holds the immutable object; fingerprint includes its canonical metadata

`Scopes\ScopeConfiguration` split, core part: new `Panels\Internal\CanonicalMetadata` (generic canonical fingerprint metadata of declarations and option objects, moved from `ScopeConfiguration::metadata/componentMetadata`); the filter/binding validation part stays in `ScopeConfiguration` until P2.8

New `Audit\AuditOptions` (Api, readonly `retentionDays`) at `packages/core/src/Audit/AuditOptions.php` (D17; i5.json entry `packages/core/src/Audit` owner P3); `AuditPlugin::register()` adds `options(new AuditOptions($days))`; `retentionIn()` removed; `AuditPruneCommand` reads `$panel->options(AuditOptions::class)?->retentionDays`

`Panel` members listed internal in knowledge/contracts#panel get `@internal` (changing, before, after, restrictions, grantConditions, doctorChecks, attachedSources, scopes, scopeDefinition, scopeDefinitions, scopeResolvers, tenantResolvers, resourceScopes); in-repo extension code (Filament, module code) stops calling them (I4 entries removed or fixed)

Retire `Panels\GateMode`, `PanelBuilder::gate()`, `PanelSettings::GATE_MODE`, config key `defaults.gate.mode` (config/azguard.php, AzGuardConfig validation → generic unknown key), `Diagnostics\Checks\GateModeCheck` and finding `gate.mode`; `gate.enabled` unchanged
`Schema\Field`: names starting with `azg_` rejected like the other reserved prefixes
Snapshots regenerated (config defaults, doctor checks, exceptions if any); migration lines for options/retentionIn, gate(), defaults.gate.mode, azg_ fields, Panel internal members

reads.why: Rules every P2 item follows (reference wins, no shims, D17 placement, attributes, snapshots, migration lines)
Report-mode allowlist protocol and which entries this item removes
Exact validation commands and driver environment
Owners/roots, Internal placement rule, stable FQCNs, composition roots — where new files go
Module options slot rule and sealing (no live objects in definitions)
defaults.gate.mode retired; all other keys frozen

rules: Two-panel fixture: different AuditOptions per panel give different fingerprints and each panel reads only its own object (I14).
Fingerprint of a panel without options is unchanged by this item (no catalog cache churn for core-only panels).
